headline: Ownership Battles Stir Across Five Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ownership ledger has quickened beyond Stlican Shelf. That sector remains the chief storm center, with four events in the latest two hours and 46 across the day; seven strategic bases are Warden-held and two Colonial-held. Weathered Expanse has plainly reawakened, recording five events in two hours and 22 in 24, amid sharply accelerating casualties, while Deadlands has two fresh events and 11 for the day as losses and enlistments continue to climb. Stonecradle and Godcrofts each logged two events in the latest two-hour watch, adding new movement to their already mixed holdings: eight Wardens to one Colonial in Stonecradle, and seven Wardens, one Colonial, and one neutral base in Godcrofts. Callahan’s Passage, once active in the earlier watch, is quiet over the latest two hours despite three events in six and five in 24; all ten bases remain Warden-held. Fisherman’s Row likewise shows no fresh movement in two hours, though six events remain on its daily ledger. The heaviest casualty pressure is concentrated in Deadlands, Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, and Stonecradle.
